WITH product_loss AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) - SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS loss_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(loss_eur), 2)
FROM product_loss
WHERE loss_eur > 0
